levels.name: Manifest foundation / no UI surface
levels.description: The target scenario has no UI surface, or its service.json / template UI manifest cannot be read and parsed. Nothing further can be assessed until the foundation is readable.
exit_criteria: A UI surface is discoverable and service.json + the template ui/manifest.json parse

levels.name: Manifest valid + static interop clean
levels.description: The UI manifest contract is valid (kind/schema/slots, overlay compatibility, slot-filesystem alignment, path-pattern vocabulary) AND every static UI-interop check passes: bridge dep/init/guard/appId, vite base, router basename, no hardcoded localhost, server standards, resolveApiBase-single, proxy-base preservation, shortcut relay / no scattered keydown, protective comments, spatial-nav-init, helmet frame-ancestors, focus-visible, banned-scroll/scrollIntoView, h-screen.
exit_criteria: No manifest validation or static UI-interop findings remain

levels.name: Freshness + code-facts wired
levels.description: The built UI bundle is fresh per the canonical content-hash freshness engine (not an mtime heuristic), and UI presence/framework are resolved via the code-facts authority rather than hand-rolled directory/port probing.
entry_criteria: Manifest and static interop are clean
exit_criteria: The UI bundle is fresh and code-facts resolves the UI surface and framework

levels.name: Runtime render passes
levels.description: Driven in a real browser via browser-automation-studio, the live UI renders correctly: iframe-bridge handshake succeeds, the storage shim engages, zero console errors, assets/proxy load, the shortcut relay reaches the host, and spatial focus works. When BAS or the UI is unavailable, runtime checks are skipped (not failed) and do not falsely grant this rung.
exit_criteria: All runtime/render checks pass when BAS is available

levels.name: Net-new standards + auto-fix implemented
levels.description: The project UI standards pass — i18n locale parity, design-token usage with no raw hex, accessibility (axe/WCAG), favicon/webmanifest/viewport, and strict-config + react-stability lint — and the safe-subset auto-fixers for the mechanical findings are implemented (fixer_status=implemented), not merely declared.
exit_criteria: Net-new UI standards pass and the declared safe fixers exist

levels.name: Full UI authority
levels.description: The entire fixable universe is implemented with zero pending fixers; static and runtime check groups are all green; the consolidated report carries no blocking findings. The scenario's UI is fully validated and self-healing for the mechanical subset.
entry_criteria: Net-new standards and safe auto-fixers are in place
exit_criteria: Zero pending fixers and no blocking findings across all check groups
